niche: an integrated care board's hypnotic deprescribing pharmacist team placed in one of six localities for 2027, sized by the emergency fall admissions it avoids among patients aged 65 or over on benzodiazepines and Z-drugs
answer: Saltreach Coast, 19 emergency admissions for a fall avoided in 2027; runner-up Hethermoss, 4 fewer
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads every field and applies every filed rule takes each current user's first start from their first item in the board's dispensing extract, prices the excess from it and files Corvenham Central at 74 admissions avoided (Saltreach Coast 55), when the extract opens on 1 April 2026 and most of Corvenham Central's users started years before; the golden is Saltreach Coast at 19.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the excess fall admissions a current user's benzodiazepine or Z-drug causes over April to December 2027, a rate ratio that falls with time since the patient first started (the susceptible fall early and leave the cohort) times the background rate, summed over the users the team takes off: how a medicines safety team prices stopping a drug, by exposure duration; swapped to tyres in a depot the reason recent users carry the risk, the prescriber's yearly re-authorised template that holds the start and the 45 in 100 who come off all lose their meaning.

spine.grain: patient x dispensing date x product

world.geography: England, an integrated care board area
invented_names: Kestrel and Wold Commissioning Support Unit

driver: A harm that eases with time since a unit's exposure began is priced from the first record of it in an activity log that opened after most exposures began, so every long-exposed unit looks newly exposed; each unit's real start lives in another record whose chain of renewals reaches back, and the candidate with the most units, mostly long exposed, loses to the one whose units began recently.
driver_concrete: The board places a deprescribing team where it avoids the most emergency fall admissions in 2027, priced by the policy's rate ratio by months since each patient first started a benzodiazepine or Z-drug; the dispensing extract opens on 1 April 2026, so dating each start from a patient's first item there makes every long-term user an April starter and names Corvenham Central, the biggest locality, when each real start is the first template of the repeat-template chain (through one practice's previous system) and Saltreach Coast's users started most recently.
stump: A competent analyst reads the policy, dates each current user's first start from their first item in the board's dispensing extract and names Corvenham Central at 74 admissions avoided, where the golden is Saltreach Coast at 19; the step that lands them there is taking the start of a record as the start of the exposure, when the extract opens on 1 April 2026 so that every patient already on the drug enters it as an April starter at the raised rate through 2027, and each patient's real first start is the first template of the repeat-template chain, where 1,888 of Saltreach Coast's current users started on or after 1 April 2025 against 477 of Corvenham Central's.

differentiation.task131: task131 moves load out of a window and prices the synchronised surge when it returns; this build prices an exposure's excess harm by time since the exposure began, nothing moved or returned
differentiation.task169: task169 corrects a forward rate for one of two processing routes a filed change closes; here no route or filed change: the harm falls with time on the drug and the start date sits in another record
differentiation.task183: task183 conditions a part's rate on its own count of past failures; this build conditions the excess risk on time since the exposure started, recovered from a start record the truncated activity log cannot show
differentiation.task230: task230 corrects a category count for a late processing channel's classification bias; nothing here is classified or processed late
differentiation.task446: task446 weights a signal by the component that raised it; here no signal or component: each unit's excess risk follows its own exposure clock
differentiation.task133: task133 fits a life table with delayed entry for loans a record watched only from a take-over; here nothing is estimated: the risk by duration is filed and each start is recovered from a second record that reaches back
differentiation.task156: task156 estimates survival with left truncation over a closed cohort; here the policy files the excess by duration and the step is dating each exposure from the prescribing record's history
differentiation.task134: task134 v2's forward inflow comes from a conversion hazard that rises after a waiting window in a pool outside the register; here the risk falls with time on the drug, the forward figure is filed by the policy, and the decisive step is recovering each exposure's start from the repeat-template history because the dispensing extract opened after most exposures began.
differentiation.task149: task149's hazard rises with the pace of work against its engineered content; here the excess fall risk depends on time since the patient first started the drug, and the step is dating that start from a second record.
differentiation.task176: task176 v2 counts units ending when a dependant reaches a fixed age, against a tenure hazard; here the rate turns on the patient's own time on the drug and the step is recovering when it began from a record that reaches back before a truncated extract.
differentiation.task452: task452 v1 reweights reference observations under a revised stratification's inclusion probabilities; here nothing is sampled or reweighted, each user's own start is recovered from the template chain.

lineage.architecture: v1 (loops 0 to 4, shipped 10-12, reshipped 10-27 after the portal's determinism block): the headlines each desk's own editors already test netted out of the squad's sized gain
lineage.fate: FAILED_TO_STUMP 2026-10-27: both portal responses filed Culture·national at 1,250,000 (the golden), by keeping the clicks from Bightline's own surfaces and dropping the articles a desk had already tested, a filter they read as obvious (a tested headline cannot be tested again); shrinkage against the change log moved only the figure, never the desk
lineage.driver: The gain a specialist team adds to a unit is its effect on the reachable volume the unit does not already treat itself, because the unit's own past trials, which supply the measured effect, have already banked their gains in the volume carried forward; every closed deployment went to units that had never run a trial of their own, so the shrunk effect times reachable volume reproduces all of them, while the unit leading on that basis already treats the items that carry most of its reachable volume and a unit that has treated little of its own overtakes it.
lineage.stump: A competent solver rebuilds each desk's winning lift from the test archive, shrinks it as the seven closed embeddings' realised holdback lifts require, counts only the clicks that start on surfaces that show the tested headline, and names Local·metro at 2,800,000; the step that lands them there is never asking who ran the tests behind each desk's lift, which the archive's test owners joined to the newsroom staff list answer: Local·metro's own editors already test the headlines behind 71.1% of its platform clicks, so most of the gain the squad was sized on is already in the plan.

lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-27 at the portal (FAILED_TO_STUMP after the determinism reship): both responses landed the call once the brief's sign-off required each closed embedding reproduced
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the share of an item's measured gain that is new to the whole system rather than taken from the items shown beside it, which is one minus the rate at which a view of the shared display already ends in a choice; a unit whose volume arrives through displays that nearly always convert keeps little of its measured gain, so the unit leading on the measured gain falls behind one whose volume arrives through displays that rarely convert.
